name: rasterizer
description: Dependencies for building the Rasterizer FFGL plugins. GLEW is only needed on Windows; macOS uses the system OpenGL framework. SVG parsing and rasterisation is nanosvg, vendored under external/nanosvg, so it is not a dependency here. This file is easy to leave behind when a new plugin repo is copied from an old one, and nothing points at it: the CMakeLists says find_package(GLEW REQUIRED) on non-Apple, macOS never needs it, and so every local build and every macOS CI job passes while the Windows job fails at configure.
